reviews.title: Can’t login anymore
reviews.text: For some reason after the last updates, I am unable to login. It is just stuck loading after i input my OTP.

reviews.title: Save your money! ⛔️
reviews.text: Stopped paying after yet another price increase, and honestly, don’t miss it. I find Apple’s built-in password manager so much more convenient. Even when I need to log in from a different device, it’s very easy to just look up my passwords..The whole security thing feels exaggerated to convince people to pay for something they don’t really need..And be careful about what happens to your passwords when you cancel your subscription. You don’t want to end up losing access to your own data just because you stopped paying to them. Not worth it.

reviews.title: Keeper is a Bully
reviews.text: I've been using the app for a couple of years now and at one point did a one year subscription. However, over the last couple of weeks Keeper makes it difficult to view your passwords. They basically try and bully you into a $91.00 agreement. I will be migrating my passwords to a new platform.

reviews.title: Awful after update
reviews.text: Oh dear oh dear!  Been using this for years and has been excellent.  Logged in recently and they have updated it.  It is absolutely ruined now.  In not sure who signed off on this update but it is properly awful.  It’s not just a matter of getting used to change, it’s fundamentally unusable now.  I will not renew next time for what is now a complete bag of rubbish!!

reviews.title: Don’t update
reviews.text: They removed pretty much all functionality unless you pay. The least they can do is allow you to edit existing entries

reviews.title: Freezes upon Logging In after Recent Update
reviews.text: Just updated the app, and now it won’t load any of my passwords or even display them after I log in. Each entry has an icon that just keeps spinning, and the only thing I can click on is the button to view recently-accessed passwords. That’s it. Nothing else works now.

reviews.title: Please stop changing the layout
reviews.text: Keeper is great for handling all my passwords but someone in their headquarters thinks it’s fine to change the layout, they got it completely wrong! What a mess!

reviews.title: Baffled
reviews.text: I have no idea why everyone seems to love Keeper.  I had nothing but a terrible experience. It is ridiculously confusing to set up and I could never get it to seamlessly autofill. It took 10 plus steps to get login and password info filled in. Other options are way better.  Yuck.

reviews.title: Big Flaw
reviews.text: One big flaw. I use this for 10 to 15 years. However, had to change the Face ID on my iPhone. Which required me to get into Keeper only with the master password or 24 character recovery phase. Neither of which I have anymore. . Called Keeper Support they said there is absolutely nothing they can do. They can’t reset. Not even if I proved to them that I am the owner of the account. Without those 2 items I lose more than a decade’s worth of credentials!

reviews.title: App freezes up after latest update
reviews.text: After the latest app update, the app freezes up every time I try to enter a 2 step authentication code from the Authenticator app I use. The issue is that after I copy and paste the code from the Authenticator app into the keeper password app and then tap login the login button will show a spinning circle on the button like it’s loading but it never does anything and just shows an spinning circle then spins endlessly and I can’t login using the app because of this issue. However I’m giving the app 2 stars instead of one star because I can still access my vault if I login using a web browser such as safari. I hope this issue is fixed asap because it is very inconvenient to have to login using a web browser every time.

reviews.title: Not able to reset a master password
reviews.text:
This app is so frustrating.
They have the entire video and instructions on how to reset a master password, but it doesn’t work! It says “the reset is not possible for this account”, contact support, which is not really clear how to do it. I will have to cancel my subscription.

reviews.title: Started good
reviews.text: Started as a good source to save passwords now nickel and dime, $13 for this $29 for that now$200 a year, not good

reviews.title: Outrageous renewal fees
reviews.text: I have been a Keeper user for years. Their annual renewal fees go up every year and this year I was quoted $70. More than triple the price of similar competitor products. So I've now abandoned Keeper and use another product. Honestly I'm pretty happy with the move away from Keeper.

reviews.title: Spams for Review Requests
reviews.text:
Update: they are CONSTANTLY begging for 5 star reviews. Obnoxious in-app spammers who don't care whether they bypass your settings with Apple. 

----

They have their own in-app popups asking for "5 Star Review" that work around Apple settings disallowing in app review requests. Designing feature to circumvent preferences paying customers went out of their way to select is inexcusable behavior.

reviews.title: Scam Pop up subscriptions tricking user to subscribe
reviews.text: Scamming type subscriptions like breach watch , made like a function  part of the app. Trick user to subscribe, and cannot cancel and refund. Other functions are okay.

reviews.title: Ruined by greed
reviews.text: I’ve used this app for almost 15 years, have hundreds of passwords saved. Now they want $43/year to continue using it.  No thanks Keeper. Just transferred everything to BitWarden, which is free and offers unlimited passwords.

reviews.title: I Cannot Login
reviews.text: I put in my password, but I cannot log in.

reviews.title: “Support” is a joke at best
reviews.text:
They want me to PAY additional for support so I can use the app  subscription I already pay for ?!?   A current subscription paid in full. 

I’ve used Keeper for several years. Had a family plan that I no longer need so I purchased a single subscription when the family plan ended.  My app won’t recognize the new subscription or allowing me to change it. It insist on me renewing the family plan that I’m not going to renew.  
Send a message to Support explaining that I have a new sub subscription that I want to use and I’m not able to because of the family plan all of the detail.  
The response I get back is that my version does qualify for support. I can click a link  for support so I can get their product operating on my device for a subscription active and paid .
Their response is as offensive as it is ridiculous. 

I can no longer recommend them. My opinion is to avoid them. If they cannot or will not support their own product, who will?

reviews.title: Technical support
reviews.text: Worst technical support, I cancel my subscription because keeper never responded to me. Used apple password, they are much better.

reviews.title: Lost passwords with paid subscription
reviews.text: I have a paid subscription of keeper security. At some point my older Iphone keeper software stopped syncing and there was no reason provided.THE SOFTWARE DID NOT SAY I NEED AN UPDATED VERSION LIKE EVERY OTHER APP DOES NOR DID IT SAY SYNC IS FAILING. When I got my new phone it synced old data from the vault and all my passwords from my old phone was lost. TO RUB IT IN KEEPER SUPPORT MADE IT LOOK LIKE AN USER ISSUE FOR NOT UPDATING. I have lost most of my passwords.and the ones I have I am not sure if it is the latest. I WOULD NOT RECOMMEND THIS PRODUCT.

I’ve used Keeper for 5+ years, including paying for their premium service during that time. I recently stopped paying, mainly because Apple Passwords served as a good back up. But, now I need to pay for Keeper Unlimited just to edit my records?…

I’ll be moving my passwords over to Apple and Google now.

reviews.title: To expensive
reviews.text: To expensive for what it is.

reviews.title: Total pain
reviews.text: All I wanted was an alphabetical index to keep track of my passwords. I didn’t really want a keeper per se but I couldn’t find anything else. I loaded it and it promptly took over my I pad. It superseded all the automatic passwords and I had to go through it. It wanted an exceedingly long password as well and every time  I would try use PayPal or word or anything I had to stop and do its password. It was such a pain I deleted it. I’m sure that is a very secure app but it slowed me down and made everything very difficult!

reviews.title: Terrible customer service
reviews.text:
I tried this app for less than an hour. It is clunky and difficult to navigate. I attempted to get my money back, but they instead forced me to pay for an entire year an hour after my purchase. DO NOT BUY!

reviews.title: App isn’t registering my Unlimited subscription and I have no way of contacting support
reviews.text:
I have paid for Keeper Unlimited for years. My last annual charge for the Keeper Unlimited plan went through on November 4th. I have a receipt from Apple which confirms this. However, when I access the app it tells me my account is expired and I need to pay for Keeper Unlimited. Despite the fact that I’ve already paid for Keeper Unlimited and have spent 2 full months unable to utilize it.

I’m completely unable to reach out to support because when I use their support request link, I receive a reply back saying I’m on the free plan so I don’t receive support. When I email, I receive a reply back that they don’t monitor their inbox.

I’m incredibly frustrated that I haven’t been able to use my paid keeper unlimited subscription over the last 2 months and even more frustrated that I cannot contact anyone to fix it.

reviews.title: Almost 300% increase in annual subscription
reviews.text: Have used Keeper for many years and recommended it to many others, but such a huge increase in the annual subscription is untenable.  Have cancelled.

reviews.title: Unsubscribed
reviews.text: I have unsubscribed from this App. I object to a rise of 263% on the previous year and will find alternatives. For what it’s worth I found the app useful for many years.

reviews.title: Beware they try to scam you
reviews.text:
I have used this for more than a few years now. I used the free trial and then was able to use this app for free for over a year. They offered my a 50% discount for the annual subscription so I thought it was a good deal to have for a year. There is no where to cancel the subscription. You have to contact support to cancel it so they don’t charge you. But if you cancel it, they take away your subscription immediately before the expiration date and threaten to delete your account. I decided not to cancel it until later. But then they decided to charge me a month in advance for the next annual fee. I have never seen a subscription service charge you a month in advance. They claimed its because of delay in charge reasons which makes no sense if I already got charged a month in advance. I requested a refund and it took several requests for them to finally fully refund me. They were able to refund me right away so the delay in charge reason is bull.
But then they removed my subscription a month early. I pointed that out so they withdrew my refund immediately and then said “your subscription has been reset to expire ___. Let me know when you are ready to delete your account or renew your subscription.” Why am I being threatened to have my account deleted when this app supposedly lets you use it for free? The only difference with the subscription is that you can add unlimited pass keys and such. The free version is apparently limited to adding new pass keys. This app tries to scam y
